card.name: Linking words before historical movements and institutions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'of', 'in' and 'and' (also 'end') right after a noun like founder, birth, role or stage, where a name of a movement, party, nation or institution comes next. Mostly history and politics prose.

modes.label: 'of' after a role or origin noun
modes.description: The word 'of' follows nouns like founder, birth, conscience or hub, before a group or movement name.
modes.example: Ignatius Loyola, founder<< of>> the Society of Jesus

modes.label: Other linking words in history text
modes.description: 'in' or 'and' sits before a country or institution name in a historical or political phrase.
modes.example: a new stage<< in>> China's bourgeois-democratic revolution

modes.label: Verb 'end' before a social ill
modes.description: The word 'end' appears in a call to action, before a large social or political target.

card.writes: It seems to push toward 'world' and away from 'press', suggesting a following phrase about the world or a large body.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in history and politics text, just before a big movement, nation or institution is named.
